case_1.acceptance: Validate the entire batch, including execution at or before horizon, atomically. One probe TOTAL across both routes, before at most one commitment. Commitment is immutable on acceptance.
case_1.command_timing: First execution is sent_tick + delay + 1; FIFO, one command per tick, after earlier reservations.
case_1.grading: A completed trip by horizon earns max(0, target_value - penalty_per_tick * completion_tick) / normalization; all other outcomes earn zero. Scores are realized.
case_1.independence: The ground states of a and b are independent. Each route has one fixed imperfect signal, generated independently conditional on its own ground state. Inspecting one route does not update the other route's ground probability.
case_1.probe: Spend probe_energy at execution to inspect a OR b. Its fixed signal equals that route's terrain with signal_accuracy. A probe event names probe_route. One shared inspection budget; inspecting both routes or repeating a probe is forbidden. Repeated log reads add no evidence.
case_1.telemetry: Briefing at tick 0 is known; every later event arrives at state_tick + delay. Reading is free.
case_1.trip: Choose one target via a, b or the safe detour; each trip includes return home. Completion tick is commitment execution tick + route duration. Expenditure occurs on departure; insufficient energy drains battery to zero and fails the trip. No idle drain.

controls.blind_selected_probe: Match selective acquisition target, resource cost and timing but ignore its signal.
controls.entropy_matched_gate: Match selective probe/skip choice; when probing choose the prior closest to 0.5.
controls.least_useful_matched_gate: Match selective probe/skip choice; when probing choose the lower-value inspection.
controls.least_useful_probe: Always choose the lower-value inspection and then use its signal; it is not guaranteed irrelevant.
controls.most_uncertain: Always inspect the terrain prior closest to 0.5, then use its signal.

exact_enumeration.aggregate: Equal weight across contexts; probability weight within each context.
exact_enumeration.weight: Product of independent route priors and each signal likelihood conditional on its own terrain.

gate: Selective matches analytical branch expectations, dominates each declared policy per context, strictly beats never/fixed-a/fixed-b in aggregate and chooses a/b/none across contexts.
next_step: Only after structural validation, separately freeze a protected model pilot. Retain all successes and failures; no automatic expansion.
scope: Two independent route unknowns, one shared inspection; constructed development cases, not continuous rover control or a model benchmark.

seeded_smoke.interpretation: Separate deterministic smoke matrix, paired across policies; not independent model repetitions.

ties: Acquisition prefers none, then a, then b; route ties are lexical; least-useful and entropy ties prefer a.
